plans.idea: Classic banner read left-to-right: a big headline filling the left two-thirds and vertically centred, with the Shop button centred on the same axis near the right margin, matching the original's composition but at full banner scale.
Centred stack: the headline is set large across the middle of the banner with the Shop button directly below it on the same centre axis, a single symmetric lockup with even whitespace on both sides.
Headline-dominant: an oversized headline fills most of the left side as the focal point, and the Shop button sits bottom-right on the headline's baseline so the eye finishes the line there.
